purpose: Controlled development pilot of retained neural opponents and heterogeneous tables. Not final qualification.
rationale: Neural continuation audit completed 30048 rollouts but action preferences remain continuation-dependent. Avoid unverified teacher labels; optimize terminal winning in complete games against a wider frozen population.

training.objective: Terminal win share, ties split; no city-count or heuristic reward changes. Truncated games excluded and reported; any truncation fails clean-screen admission.

population.homogeneous: One sampled family for all opposing seats.
population.heterogeneous: Independently sample each opposing seat from the same marginal distribution.
population.pairing: Same population selfplay draw and first opponent draw in both population arms; 2p assignments are identical. Existing-mixture control is a separate recipe comparison.
population.opponent_inference: Greedy frozen/snapshot policies; learner sampled from current policy. Freeze parameters and exclude from optimizer.
population.hidden_information: No change to schema-4 public-information contract; roles never enter feature tensors.

checkpoint_selection: Screen latest at both scheduled updates, never internal best. Preserve immutable revisions and hashes before subsequent uploads overwrite latest.

evaluation.matches_per_deal: Every candidate seat crossed with all four rule combinations.
evaluation.candidates: Starting H200 update79 plus each of the six scheduled arm/checkpoint combinations, all on identical deals.
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: gameSeed, retaining every seat and rule repeat

comparisons.primary: Heterogeneous minus homogeneous at update19, separately for each player count/opponent.
secondary: Each population arm minus existing-mixture control at update19.
Each arm minus starting H200 update79 at update19.
Inspect every original/open, original/sealed, recharged/open, recharged/sealed subgroup.
comparisons.priority_failures: 2p economic floor and frozen A260 3p floor remain unsatisfied by the parent. Do not pool away these weaknesses.

validation: 2553-fixture checkpoint/export comparison, including strict numerical tolerances; record failures and do not qualify failing exports.
Exact candidate and opponent hashes, counts, seed sets, unique seat/rule/deal keys and paired completeness.
Zero actual-game truncations, illegal actions and search truncations; explicit search diagnostics.
Inspect training metrics for both arms: completed games, truncation, admission mode and actual snapshot updates.
Verify frozen and initial checkpoint SHA256, schema, architecture and update.
Verify actual opponent-seat counts, completed games and snapshot updates in every training batch.
Do not interpret async engine blocking time as total CPU use. Record policy, rollout and optimization wall times before scaling hardware.
interpretation: One training seed is a pilot, not proof of robustness.
Asynchronous scheduling can change action-sampling trajectories; paired seeds do not imply identical training games.
Bootstrap intervals are marginal exploratory intervals, not family-wise bounds.
No final-reserved seeds, no deployment, no strength-gate weakening.

Retain and report every arm, scheduled checkpoint and regression. If screens support a candidate, run stronger independent search and mixed-opponent follow-ups and a second training seed before final qualification.
